_comment: WP06_VO locked casting (GDD 4.3, ASSET_MANIFEST VOICE_*). Never change voice, settings, seed base or style mid-production. EL take n uses seed = seed + 1000*(n-1). Delivery from DIALOGUE.json goes into the leading EL tag or into Gemini style_instructions, never into the spoken text. Accent words are kept faint and never put into EL tags (guardrail: no caricatured accents).

vo_sparrow.style: Alto woman in her thirties, a case officer on a covert team: measured and precise, dry wit, a faint natural Cuban-American Miami lilt that is never exaggerated. Never theatrical. Realistic, unpolished field delivery, not an announcer.

vo_tinker.style: Quick Louisiana tenor in his thirties, a radio and demolitions man on a covert team: nervous energy, gallows humor, voice rises when excited. Only a faint, natural Cajun hint, never exaggerated or comic. Realistic, unpolished field delivery.

vo_calder.style: Exhausted, sedated man in his mid-thirties strapped to a chair in an interrogation room. Hoarse, flat Western Pennsylvania vowels, short sentences, audible breath between them. Quiet, close, realistic, never theatrical.

vo_harrou.style: Velvet baritone in his sixties addressing a town over loudspeakers: precise and unhurried, Continental-educated English with no identifiable national accent, amused contempt. Measured public-address cadence with clear pauses between phrases.

vo_clockmaker.style: Flat, emotionless, evenly spaced, like a machine reading digits. A single word, spoken once, clearly, with no intonation and no breath.

vo_greycoat.style: Low, clipped, disciplined soldier speaking quietly into a radio in an unfamiliar language; pronounce every word exactly as spelled. Short, hard consonants, no emotion.

tokens._comment: VO_CLOCKMAKER_TOKENS: one call per token, 3 takes; key -> spoken prompt
